facts.text: Luther College's Paideia core program includes three required courses: Paideia 111 and 112: Enduring Questions in the first year, followed by Paideia 450: Ethical Choices as a junior or senior.

sources.title: Paideia | Luther College
sources.quote: Paideia includes three courses. In your first year, you will complete Paideia 111 and 112: Enduring Questions. When you are a junior or a senior, you will take Paideia 450: Ethical Choices.
